title: Your encounters, ready to use again

features.title: A local scene library
features.description: Save a scene and it appears in Encounters & scenes with a preview of the complete build. Search the library or add older scene files.

features.title: Drag entire builds into worlds
features.description: Click or drag a library scene onto a world, just like terrain. Each placement is an independent group. Reopen it as an editable scene on an encounter slate.

features.title: Saved on your computer
features.description: Scene files embed their previews. A local library copy keeps the geometry and layouts available across restarts, with no account or internet connection.
